# Josh Turek Watchdog File

**Subject:** Josh Turek, Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Iowa, 2026, state representative
**Compiled:** October 25, 2026 for the On Point Politics watchdog database, onpointpolitics.us
**Data cutoff:** October 24, 2026. The latest candidate figures found are second quarter 2026 FEC reports through June 30, 2026.
**Next scheduled data drop:** FEC pre-general report covering through October 14, 2026, which was not found in this pass, then the post-general report due December 3, 2026.

## Bottom line up front

Turek is a small donor candidate carried by national Democratic outside money. He raised $6,276,527 through June 30, 2026 and outraised Ashley Hinson in the second quarter, $2,813,428 to $2,059,828, but held $2,362,314 in cash against her $6,749,491, per Little Village on July 17, 2026, https://littlevillagemag.com/turek-democrats-outraise-republicans/.

Three interests combine real money with a decision he would touch:

1. **National Democratic leadership.** Senate Majority PAC reserved $13.4 million in May and added $17 million on July 23, 2026. Chuck Schumer's leadership PAC gave him the maximum. The decision is which party organizes the Senate in January 2027.
2. **VoteVets.** Its super PAC spent about $10 million to win him the June 2 primary, more than both campaigns combined. He says he wants dark money out of politics.
3. **Small donors.** The campaign claims nearly 53,000 donors averaging $33. No single donor has measurable leverage.

## Committee structure and treasurer

The principal campaign committee's name, FEC ID and treasurer were not verified in this pass, and the roster has no FEC ID for him. No leadership PAC or joint fundraising committee was found. His only government income found is the Iowa House per diem.

Scale. He raised roughly $678,000 in the fourth quarter of 2025 and ended the year with $398,474, per the Cedar Rapids Gazette, https://www.thegazette.com/campaigns-elections/ashley-hinson-takes-massive-fundraising-edge-in-iowas-open-seat-u-s-senate-campaign/. He raised $1,122,303 in the first quarter and $2,813,428 in the second, per Little Village.

## National Democratic leadership

Documented. Schumer's leadership PAC gave the maximum allowable gift before the primary, per the Washington Sun on June 2, 2026, https://www.washingtonsun.com/2026-election/josh-turek-iowa-primary-win-november. Groups tied to Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand also gave, per Scripps on June 2, 2026, https://www.abc15.com/politics/paralympic-athlete-wins-key-iowa-democratic-senate-primary. Senate Majority PAC reserved $13.4 million of fall television in May and announced $17 million more on July 23, 2026. It says the ads focus on Hinson's votes on prices, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act's Medicaid cuts and tariffs, per the Carroll Times Herald reprinting Iowa Capital Dispatch, https://carrollspaper.com/news/state/national-democratic-pac-announces-17m-fall-ad-buy-targeting-ashley-hinson/article_e0ddbe2b-627a-5a45-87c1-1e78edda100a.html. Its nonprofit arm, Majority Forward, runs separate health care ads.

What they want. A Senate majority. The NRSC answered on primary night with an ad calling him Chuck Schumer's puppet.

Inference: The money that matters most to Turek is not given to him. It is spent for him by committees tied to Senate Democratic leadership, so the leader vote in January 2027 is the decision those committees care about. He has not said publicly how he would cast it in sources read.

## VoteVets

Documented. VoteVets spent about $10 million in the primary, while Turek and Zach Wahls each spent about $1.5 million on ads per AdImpact, per the Washington Sun. The Washington Free Beacon counted nearly $9 million in FEC filings on May 18, 2026. It reported that Senate Majority PAC has given VoteVets about $31 million since 2014, and that Senate Majority PAC says it sent nothing this cycle, https://freebeacon.com/elections/iowa-democratic-senate-hopeful-josh-turek-skips-vote-on-veterans-funding-to-rub-elbows-with-schumer-aligned-super-pac/. On May 1, 2026 he missed a House vote on HF 2782, a veterans appropriation, around a VoteVets Action Fund event he had promoted. His spokesperson said the vote was rescheduled four times and 17 members of both parties missed it.

What he said. He wants to see all dark money groups get out of politics and says VoteVets decided to support him without coordination.

Inference: The hop two chain is Senate Majority PAC to VoteVets and VoteVets to Turek's race. This file does not store Senate Majority PAC to Turek through VoteVets, because no filing shows that chain this cycle.

## Small donors

Documented. The campaign claimed nearly 53,000 individual donors with a $33 average, per the Telegraph Herald on May 14, 2026, https://www.telegraphherald.com/news/tri-state/article_2cd0cb77-bdc6-4bc9-b3b4-8a1db6f769cc.amp.html. Fox News reported $43,000 raised from Southern California donors from March 25 to 31 and $36,500 from Washington donors from February 17 to March 23, 2026, https://www.foxnews.com/politics/dem-senate-hopeful-pocketed-massive-taxpayer-funded-cash-while-skipping-hundreds-votes.

Inference: The broad base limits any single donor's leverage. The out of state events are what opponents use to tie his fundraising to his missed votes.

## Own finances and disclosure history

No Senate candidate financial disclosure was read. Fox reports about $20,100 in tax free legislative per diem at $201 a day, which state law allows. His background, per Ballotpedia News on August 6, 2026, https://news.ballotpedia.org/2026/08/06/turek-hinson-running-for-open-u-s-senate-seat-in-iowa-as-ernst-retires/, is a former professional wheelchair basketball player and Paralympic medalist. He won his first House race by six votes and was reelected by five points.

## Enforcement and controversies

- No FEC or ethics complaint against Turek was found in sources read.
- Missed votes. Fox News reported on July 8, 2026 that he missed 261 House votes from January 12 to May 3, 2026, nearly 60 percent. His campaign said the pattern is not unique, pointed to Hinson missing part of a June 24 defense markup for a fundraiser, and called him one of Iowa's most bipartisan lawmakers.
- The Senate Leadership Fund flew a State Fair banner on August 17 saying he was in Nantucket and ran an ad saying he is only showing up for himself, per Bleeding Heartland on August 24, 2026, https://www.bleedingheartland.com/?p=458547.

## Deal table

| Interest | Money in | Ask | Lever | Stake | Decision date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Senate Democratic leadership | Schumer PAC maximum; Senate Majority PAC $13.4M plus $17M | Senate majority | Leader and organizing vote | Control of the Senate | January 2027 |
| VoteVets | About $10M primary spending | Veterans agenda | Votes on VA and defense | Not quantified | 2027 to 2028 |
| Small donors | $6.28M raised through June 30 | Not stated | None specific | Not quantified | Not applicable |

## Levers and calendar

| Decision | Who holds it now | When | Which donors care |
|---|---|---|---|
| Senate organizing and leader vote | Senate Republicans, 53 to 45 | January 2027 | Senate Majority PAC, Schumer PAC |
| Super PAC and dark money limits | Congress | 2027 to 2028 | VoteVets |
| Medicaid after the 2025 law | Congress | 2027 to 2028 | Health care interests, allied ad groups |
| Confirmations | Senate | 2027 to 2028 | Every regulated bloc |

Calendar. The election is November 3, 2026. The FEC post-general report is due December 3, 2026. The new Congress convenes in January 2027, when the organizing vote happens. Budget and reconciliation fights run through 2027 and 2028.

## What we could not verify

- Committee name, FEC ID and treasurer; any joint fundraising committee.
- Third quarter and pre-general totals.
- Top individual donors and PAC amounts beyond the Schumer PAC maximum.
- Who funds VoteVets this cycle beyond the historical Senate Majority PAC figure.
- His Senate financial disclosure.
- Bodies not read: https://iowacapitaldispatch.com/briefs/national-democratic-pac-announces-17m-fall-ad-buy-targeting-ashley-hinson/ which was read through the Carroll reprint, https://www.nwestiowa.com/sentinel/iowa-politicians-raise-millions-ahead-of-midterms/article_5d07dc5a-92c7-4ff0-958f-448c8a862822.html and https://votevets.org/press-releases/votevets-launches-new-ad-in-support-of-josh-turek-for-iowa and https://www.kwit.org/podcast/spm-news/2026-04-17/hinson-leads-u-s-senate-candidates-in-iowa-in-fundraising

# Josh Turek research notes

Audit trail for IA-josh-turek, compiled October 25, 2026. Search budget was about five searches for this subject, shared with the Hinson file.

## Thread 1: Committees and totals

### Takeaway
Totals are clear through June 30, 2026. The committee ID and treasurer are not.

### Cited findings
- Q4 2025 about $678,000; cash $398,474 at year end. https://www.thegazette.com/campaigns-elections/ashley-hinson-takes-massive-fundraising-edge-in-iowas-open-seat-u-s-senate-campaign/
- Q1 2026 $1.1M raised, $763,000 spent, $757,000 cash; campaign claims nearly 53,000 donors at $33 average. https://www.telegraphherald.com/news/tri-state/article_2cd0cb77-bdc6-4bc9-b3b4-8a1db6f769cc.amp.html
- Q1 $1,122,303; Q2 $2,813,428; cycle $6,276,527; cash $2,362,314 on June 30. https://littlevillagemag.com/turek-democrats-outraise-republicans/
- Ballotpedia News lists $3.91M for Turek as of June 30, which matches his Q1 plus Q2 receipts, not his cycle total. https://news.ballotpedia.org/2026/08/06/turek-hinson-running-for-open-u-s-senate-seat-in-iowa-as-ernst-retires/

### Inferences
- Ballotpedia's figure is likely a 2026 only sum. Not stored as a cycle total.

### Gaps
- Q3 and pre-general totals. Several searches did not surface them.

## Thread 2: Outside money

### Takeaway
VoteVets won him the primary; Senate Majority PAC carries the general.

### Cited findings
- VoteVets about $10M; each campaign about $1.5M on ads per AdImpact; Schumer leadership PAC maxed out; NRSC puppet ad. https://www.washingtonsun.com/2026-election/josh-turek-iowa-primary-win-november
- VoteVets nearly $9M per FEC filings; Senate Majority PAC gave VoteVets about $31M since 2014, none this cycle per SMP; HF 2782 missed vote and spokesperson response; Turek quote on dark money. https://freebeacon.com/elections/iowa-democratic-senate-hopeful-josh-turek-skips-vote-on-veterans-funding-to-rub-elbows-with-schumer-aligned-super-pac/
- Gillibrand tied groups gave; VoteVets likely to invest more. https://www.abc15.com/politics/paralympic-athlete-wins-key-iowa-democratic-senate-primary
- SMP $13.4M in May and $17M on July 23, 2026; Majority Forward health care ads. https://carrollspaper.com/news/state/national-democratic-pac-announces-17m-fall-ad-buy-targeting-ashley-hinson/article_e0ddbe2b-627a-5a45-87c1-1e78edda100a.html
- One Nation $11M for Hinson; SLF Nantucket banner and ad. https://www.bleedingheartland.com/?p=458547
- Legis1 relays the Washington Post on VoteVets nearly $10M. https://legis1.com/news/iowa-senate-2026-election-whos-paying-for-the

### Inferences
- Leadership aligned money is the dominant bloc.

### Gaps
- VoteVets general election spending.

## Thread 3: Record and controversies

### Cited findings
- 261 missed votes, per diem about $20,100, California and D.C. fundraising, campaign response. https://www.foxnews.com/politics/dem-senate-hopeful-pocketed-massive-taxpayer-funded-cash-while-skipping-hundreds-votes
- Won first House race by six votes, reelected by five points. https://news.ballotpedia.org/2026/08/06/turek-hinson-running-for-open-u-s-senate-seat-in-iowa-as-ernst-retires/

### Gaps
- Senate financial disclosure; legislative votes on money relevant bills.

## Campaign intel

- Main message: electability and personal story. He is a Paralympic gold medalist who won a Trump district, says the race is about having a senator fighting for the people of Iowa, and pitches himself to independents and moderate Republicans. https://www.abc15.com/politics/paralympic-athlete-wins-key-iowa-democratic-senate-primary and https://www.washingtonsun.com/2026-election/josh-turek-iowa-primary-win-november
- Biggest vulnerability as opponents frame it: attendance. Fox counts 261 missed Iowa House votes from January 12 to May 3, 2026 while he raised money out of state, and the Senate Leadership Fund says he is only showing up for himself. His campaign says Hinson also skipped work for a fundraiser. https://www.foxnews.com/politics/dem-senate-hopeful-pocketed-massive-taxpayer-funded-cash-while-skipping-hundreds-votes and https://www.bleedingheartland.com/?p=458547
- Second line of attack: Republicans call him Chuck Schumer's puppet, and Schumer's leadership PAC did give him the maximum. https://www.washingtonsun.com/2026-election/josh-turek-iowa-primary-win-november
- Strongest coalition: a broad small donor base the campaign puts at nearly 53,000 donors, and a record of winning a Trump district. He outraised Hinson in the second quarter, $2.81M to $2.06M. https://www.telegraphherald.com/news/tri-state/article_2cd0cb77-bdc6-4bc9-b3b4-8a1db6f769cc.amp.html and https://littlevillagemag.com/turek-democrats-outraise-republicans/
- Notable recent event: Senate Majority PAC added $17M in fall ads on July 23 on top of a $13.4M reservation. As of August 24 Cook and Fox call the race a toss up, Inside Elections tilts Republican and Sabato leans Hinson. https://carrollspaper.com/news/state/national-democratic-pac-announces-17m-fall-ad-buy-targeting-ashley-hinson/article_e0ddbe2b-627a-5a45-87c1-1e78edda100a.html and https://www.bleedingheartland.com/?p=458547
- Cash gap: Hinson held $6,749,491 to his $2,362,314 on June 30, 2026. https://littlevillagemag.com/turek-democrats-outraise-republicans/
